text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthday, Ikuno. It's not much,<n>but I have a
present for you as well.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Oh? You didn't have to, but thank you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...Aw, I didn't know you guys were<n>so close.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
When you put it so plainly, I do feel a<n>bit bashful,
but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
From having the proper mindset<n>before a race to
the importance of<n>thinking ahead, I've learned
much<n>from Ikuno's example.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
So I guess you're kinda like a mentor<n>to McQueen
then, huh, Ikuno?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I find it difficult to believe myself, but<n>if my advice
has been of use to you,<n>then I'm glad.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Did you find the list of places with<n>low-calorie
sweets I gave you the<n>other day helpful?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
About that... it's embarrassing to<n>admit, but I've
already been to all of<n>them. I cannot thank you
enough...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Guess you look to Ikuno's<n>advice for a lot
more than just racing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
A-anyhow, I'm grateful for all you do,<n>and hope
you'll allow me to gleam<n>more knowledge from you
in the<n>future.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Of course, you can expect more tips<n>on new sweets
to try.
